error.description: Check the notification service and that your session still holds the platform admin role.

empty.description: Announcements sent from the platform appear here.

notFound.title: This announcement does not exist.
notFound.description: It may have been addressed by a stale link.

PROMOTION.label: Promotion
PROMOTION.hint: Carries an offer, a link and a discount code.

MAINTENANCE.label: Maintenance
MAINTENANCE.hint: States a downtime window. Both ends required.

SYSTEM.label: System
SYSTEM.hint: The platform speaking about itself. No links, no offers.

composer.title: Compose an announcement
composer.description: Delivered once to the people you choose — a named list, one workspace, or everyone. There is no draft, no schedule and no recall.
composer.messageHint: Plain text. The notification service refuses anything that looks like an HTML tag.
composer.noPayloadFields: A system notice carries no link, image or discount code. The service refuses them on this type.
composer.downtimeHint: Entered in your own time zone and sent as an absolute instant.
